detailed_task_description: This workflow automates uploading a file to a specific Google Drive folder. The user opens Google Chrome via Spotlight, navigates to a pre-bookmarked Google Drive directory, and creates a new folder with a user-defined name. After opening the newly created folder, the workflow initiates a file upload via the Drive UI, locates the target file in the system file picker using a quick-search character, and confirms the upload. The end result is the selected file residing inside the newly created Google Drive folder.
success_criteria: Verify that the uploaded file appears inside the newly created '{folder_name}' folder in the target Google Drive directory, and the Drive upload progress indicator shows the upload as complete.

subtasks.text: Launch Google Chrome via Spotlight search, open a new browser tab, and navigate to the target Google Drive directory by clicking the 'ai mime - binary' bookmark. Expected outcome: The correct Google Drive folder is open and visible in the browser.

steps.expected_current_state: macOS desktop with Spotlight search bar open and active, currently showing a previous search query.
steps.intent: Type "chrome" into the Spotlight search bar to find and open Google Chrome.

target.primary: Spotlight search input field, centered near the top of the screen
target.fallback: Search bar with magnifying glass icon, open in the middle of the desktop

post_action: The Spotlight search bar updates with the typed text and Google Chrome launches, appearing as a new window on the right side of the screen.

steps.expected_current_state: The browser window is partially visible on the right side of the screen with the address bar or navigation input focused, ready to navigate to a URL.
steps.intent: Confirm the URL entry in the browser address bar to navigate to the tasks page.

target.primary: browser address bar near the top of the browser window

post_action: The browser navigates to the tasks page and displays a task management dashboard.
The AI Mime Tasks page becomes the active tab showing a list of tasks with statuses.

steps.expected_current_state: Chrome browser showing the AI Mime Tasks page with a list of tasks. Multiple tabs are open in the browser.
steps.intent: Open a new browser tab by clicking the new tab button in the tab bar.

target.primary: New Tab button ('+' icon) at the far right of the browser tab bar
target.fallback: empty space to the right of the last open tab in the tab bar

post_action: A new tab opens in the browser.
The new tab page is displayed with a clock and bookmark shortcuts.

steps.expected_current_state: A Chrome new tab page is open with a decorative background and bookmarks visible. The address bar shows a "G" icon indicating it is ready for navigation.
steps.intent: Click on the "ai mime - binary -..." bookmark in the bookmarks bar to navigate to the corresponding Google Drive folder.

target.primary: "ai mime - binary -..." bookmark with a Google Drive icon in the bookmarks bar, near the top of the browser

post_action: The browser navigates to a Google Drive folder page.
The tab title and URL update to reflect the Google Drive folder for "ai mime - binary".

subtasks.text: In the open Google Drive directory, open the New menu, select 'New folder', type the folder name '{folder_name}', click Create, then double-click the new folder to open it. Expected outcome: A new folder named '{folder_name}' has been created and opened inside the Drive directory.

steps.expected_current_state: Google Drive is open in the browser showing a folder's contents. The "+ New" button in the left sidebar has been clicked and a dropdown menu is now visible with options including New folder, File upload, Folder upload, and Google Docs/Sheets/Slides etc.
steps.intent: Click "File upload" from the New dropdown menu to initiate a file upload.

target.primary: File upload option in the dropdown menu, below New folder
target.fallback: Second item in the New dropdown menu labeled File upload

post_action: A dropdown menu appears with options including New folder, File upload, Folder upload, and Google app options.
The menu is now expanded and visible over the Drive file listing.

steps.expected_current_state: Google Drive is open in a browser with a context/dropdown menu visible, showing options like "New folder", "File upload", "Folder upload", and Google Workspace app options.
steps.intent: Click "New folder" in the dropdown menu to create a new folder in the current Drive directory.

target.primary: New folder option at the top of the dropdown menu
target.fallback: First item in the context menu near the top-left of the screen

post_action: The dropdown menu closes and a 'New folder' dialog appears in the center of the screen.
The dialog contains a text field pre-filled with 'Untitled folder' and Cancel/Create buttons.

steps.expected_current_state: Google Drive is open in a browser with a "New folder" dialog box visible. The folder name input field is active and contains the default placeholder text "Untitled folder" selected.
steps.intent: Type the new folder name into the folder name input field, replacing the default text.

target.primary: text input field inside the New folder dialog, containing 'Untitled folder' placeholder text

post_action: The input field now displays the newly typed folder name.
The Create button becomes visually highlighted/focused.

steps.expected_current_state: Google Drive is open in a browser showing a folder. A "New folder" dialog is displayed with a folder name already typed in the text field, and Cancel/Create buttons at the bottom.
steps.intent: Click the "Create" button to confirm and create the new folder.

target.primary: Create button in the bottom-right of the New folder dialog
target.fallback: button labeled Create inside the popup modal

post_action: The dialog closes and the new folder appears in the Drive folder view.
The newly created folder is shown as selected in the file list.

steps.expected_current_state: Google Drive is open showing a folder's contents in grid view, with one folder item selected and multiple folders visible in the main area.
steps.intent: Double-click the "v0 - 30 May" folder to open it.

target.primary: folder labeled "v0 - 30 May" in the center of the main content area
target.fallback: middle folder in the grid of three folders

post_action: The folder opens and its contents are displayed (empty folder with a drop-files prompt).
The breadcrumb navigation updates to show the opened folder name.

subtasks.text: Initiate a file upload from within the '{folder_name}' folder by opening the New menu and selecting 'File upload', then locate and select the target file in the system file picker using the quick-search shortcut, and confirm the selection to begin uploading. Expected outcome: The file is successfully uploaded into the '{folder_name}' folder in Google Drive.

steps.expected_current_state: Google Drive is open in the browser showing an empty folder. A dropdown menu has appeared after clicking the "New" button, displaying options including "New folder", "File upload", "Folder upload", and Google app options.
steps.intent: Click "File upload" from the New menu to open a file picker for uploading a file to Google Drive.

target.primary: File upload option in the dropdown menu, below New folder
target.fallback: Second item in the New menu dropdown, labeled File upload

post_action: The dropdown menu expands or a file picker dialog opens.
The system file browser is triggered for selecting a file to upload.

steps.expected_current_state: Google Drive is open in a browser with a context/new-item dropdown menu visible, showing options like New folder, File upload, Folder upload, and Google app shortcuts.
steps.intent: Click "File upload" in the dropdown menu to open the system file picker.

target.primary: File upload option in the dropdown menu, below New folder
target.fallback: Second item in the New dropdown menu with a file icon

post_action: The dropdown menu closes.
A system file picker dialog opens, showing the local file system for browsing and selecting a file.

steps.expected_current_state: A macOS file picker dialog is open over a Google Drive browser tab. The middle column shows the contents of a project folder, and the "dist" subfolder is selected, revealing its contents — including several files — in the right column panel.
steps.intent: Select the "AI Mime.dmg" file from the dist folder's file listing in the right panel.

target.primary: AI Mime.dmg file entry in the right column of the file picker, under the 'Today' section
target.fallback: second item labeled 'Al Mime.dmg' in the rightmost visible file list column

post_action: The AI Mime.dmg file becomes highlighted/selected in blue.
A preview panel appears on the far right showing the file's icon, size, and metadata, and the Open button becomes active.

steps.expected_current_state: A macOS file picker dialog is open over a Google Drive browser tab. A file named "AI Mime.dmg" is currently selected (highlighted in blue) in the right column of the file browser, inside the "dist" folder.
steps.intent: Type a character to trigger quick-search/navigation within the file picker's file list.

target.primary: Selected file item 'AI Mime.dmg' highlighted in blue in the right column of the file picker dialog
target.fallback: File list area in the right panel of the macOS file picker dialog

post_action: The file name label on the selected item enters an inline edit/highlight state.
The file list focus remains on the same item with visible text cursor or selection indicator.

steps.expected_current_state: A macOS file picker dialog is open over Google Drive in the browser. A .dmg file is selected in the file list, with its details shown in the right preview panel.
steps.intent: Confirm the file selection by clicking the Open button to proceed with the upload.

target.primary: Open button in the bottom-right corner of the file picker dialog
target.fallback: Blue 'Open' button near the Cancel button at the bottom of the dialog

post_action: The Open button is clicked (highlighted with a dashed outline in POST screenshot).
The file picker dialog begins to close and the selected file is submitted for upload.

steps.expected_current_state: A macOS file picker dialog is open over the Google Drive browser tab. A .dmg file is selected in the file browser, and its metadata is visible in the right preview pane. The "Open" button is visible in the bottom-right corner of the dialog.
steps.intent: Click the "Open" button to confirm the file selection and begin uploading the selected file.

target.primary: "Open" button in the bottom-right corner of the file picker dialog
target.fallback: blue "Open" button near "Cancel" at the bottom-right of the dialog

post_action: The file picker dialog closes.
The selected file begins uploading to Google Drive.
